name: Eklavvya AI Answer Sheet Checking (OSM Auto Evaluation)
target_customers: universities, schools, coaching institutes, certification and corporate exam bodies

handwritten_reading.evidence: OCR "converts handwritten content into accurate, indexed digital text"; scanned booklets are OCR-processed

subjective_ai_marking.evidence: LLM scores each answer against the model answer and gives a draft AI score per question and total

stem_maths.evidence: Coaching page lists Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics subjective problems and shows derivation/ray-diagram feedback; equation handling not described

rubric_marking_scheme.evidence: Model answer per question plus four evaluation modes (Easy, Default, Moderate, Strict); product page says grading follows rubrics

partial_marks_feedback.evidence: Partial credit assessed; reviewers see the AI's reasoning under "Why this score" for each question

typed_answers.evidence: A separate Auto Descriptive Answer Evaluation page refers to online descriptive tests but does not state that typed answers are graded

indian_languages.evidence: Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Kannada, Gujarati, Malayalam listed; model answer must be in the same language as the response

bulk_scan_ingest.evidence: Scanner role uploads scanned booklets into OSM; vendor claims 100,000+ answer sheets per session

student_identification.evidence: Student identity masked under a QR/bar code for blind marking; name/roll reading not described

annotated_copy.evidence: Students can view scanned evaluated scripts; on-page AI annotation not described

teacher_review.evidence: Examiner can Accept, Override or Comment per question; moderator and re-evaluator keep an audit trail of AI and human scores

question_paper_import.evidence: FAQ: team helps you upload your first question paper during setup; automatic reading into questions not described

public_api.evidence: Product page: connect with any REST API, plus MCP, Make and n8n; no public grading API docs found

integrity_checks.evidence: No plagiarism or AI-writing detection mentioned on the AI checking pages

scale.customers_claimed: Client names shown (NMIMS, Sharda University, Delhi Public School, WeSchool, Tata Power); no total count
scale.funding_or_owner_notes: Copyright Splashgain Technology Solutions Pvt Ltd; ISO 27001 and CERT-In claimed. AI evaluation is an Enterprise feature, enabled per organisation plan
